pdf.explainTitle: What a hub and spoke strategy is
pdf.explainP1: A hub and spoke strategy organises the content of a website around a few main topics. Each topic has a pillar page (hub) that covers it thoroughly and a set of cluster articles (spokes) that explore one aspect in depth: a comparison, prices, a frequent question, a variant.
pdf.explainP2: The spokes link back to their pillar page and the pillar page links to its spokes. This network of internal links helps search engines understand that the site covers the topic in depth and helps readers find the answer they are looking for.
pdf.explainP3: The plan in this document comes from the project keywords: similar searches are grouped on the same page and every page has a suggested H1 and a suggested H2 outline. Headings and groupings are a starting point to adapt to the tone and the offer of the site.
pdf.summaryTruncated: The scope had more than 5000 keywords: the plan uses the 5000 with the highest priority.
pdf.workOrderIntro: The pages in the recommended order: each pillar page, then its spokes from the most important.
pdf.criteriaRules: Rules: a spoke needs at least {minKeywords} keywords or {minVolume} monthly searches; at most {maxSpokes} spokes per hub; a question becomes a spoke from {questionVolume} monthly searches ({questionsAs, select, spokes {every question is a spoke} other {the others go to the FAQ of the closest page}}).

plan.meta: Built on {date} · {pages, plural, one {# page} other {# pages}}

empty.title: There is no plan yet
empty.text: Titan SEO organizes the kept keywords into main pages and in-depth articles, with suggested titles and outlines. Then you write them one at a time.

plan.deleteText: The plan “{name}” goes away with its pages and their status; if there is a previous version, it becomes the plan.

progress.label: Writing progress
progress.text: {published, number} published · {writing, number} in progress · {todo, number} to write

column.unassignedHint: Drag a keyword onto a card or use its menu.

card.keywords: {count, plural, one {# keyword} other {# keywords}} · {volume, number} searches/month

plan.conflict: Another member changed the plan: I loaded the latest version.

panel.deleteText: The page “{title}” goes away and its keywords move to the ones without a page.

ai.title: AI suggestion
ai.rateLimited: You have reached the suggestion limit: you can ask for another one from {time}.
ai.droppedH2: {count, plural, one {One more proposed heading was not kept.} other {# more proposed headings were not kept.}}

regenerateDialog.title: Regenerate the plan
regenerateDialog.text: I reorganize the pages not started yet with today's kept keywords. The pages being written or published stay as they are.

versionsPage.title: Previous versions of the plan
versionsPage.intro: Every time you regenerate the plan, the previous one stays here, read only. Up to 20 are kept, then the oldest goes away.
versionsPage.empty: No previous versions: the plan has not been regenerated yet.
versionsPage.deleteText: The version “{name}” goes away; the current plan does not change.
